name: Coochiemudlo Island Progress Association
description: Volunteer island association publishing public meeting and community event notices. Its stated objectives include identifying community needs, supporting local organisations and representing residents in dealings with government.

participationNotes: The association's published objectives state that it remains apolitical, non-religious and non-sectarian. Posting requirements are not published on the checked page.

participationNotes: The sample issue invites ideas, events and organisations for possible features through its published editorial contact routes. It does not promise publication.

participationNotes: The website asks visitors taking a tour to wear covered footwear. Posting requirements are not published on the checked page.

participationNotes: Posting requirements not published on the checked page.

participationNotes: Posting requirements not published on the checked page.

participationNotes: Probus South Pacific's Redlands club guide invites prospective visitors to register interest through its linked form. Speaker proposal and publication requirements are not stated on the checked club pages.

participationNotes: The Queensland Probus profile expressly encourages visitors to attend a meeting. Requirements for proposing a guest speaker or submitting club material are not published on the checked pages.

participationNotes: The club profile welcomes new members and asks prospective visitors to contact its secretary before attending a meeting or activity. Speaker proposal and publication requirements are not stated.

name: Quandamooka Yoolooburrabee Aboriginal Corporation (QYAC)
area: Quandamooka Country, including Minjerribah and Moreton Bay
description: QYAC manages the recognised native title rights and interests of the Quandamooka People. Its public work includes cultural heritage, caring for Country, arts, education and community publications.
sampleTitle: Public news, annual reports and media channels
notes: The official media page supplies reports, publications and links to QYAC's own social channels. The page is undated, and report periods are not treated as publication dates. The homepage's indexed content supplies its general administration contact; a direct fetch of that homepage timed out during this check.
participationNotes: Use the corporation's published administration route for general organisational enquiries. Its native title role concerns the Quandamooka People; the listing does not present QYAC as representing every Indigenous person or organisation in Redlands.

name: Minjerribah Moorgumpin Elders-in-Council
area: Minjerribah and Moorgumpin, with an office in Dunwich
description: Elders-led cultural organisation preserving and teaching the culture, languages and traditions of the Goenpul, Ngugi and Noonuccal peoples. It publishes information about cultural awareness training, on-Country tours, talks and publications.
sampleTitle: Cultural awareness training and on-Country tours and talks
notes: The official services and contact pages were readable and verify the organisation's public offerings and Facebook page. The services page is undated. The homepage timed out during checking. The contact route is the organisation's office, not private contact information for individual Elders.
participationNotes: The services page provides booking-request routes. Minimum participant numbers vary, and places or activities are confirmed with Elders according to cultural protocols and the programme. Enquiries do not establish a booking or access to private activities.

name: Yulu-Burri-Ba Aboriginal Corporation for Community Health
description: Aboriginal community-controlled health organisation providing primary care, social and family wellbeing services. Its public community newsletter archive includes 2026 editions and information about its programmes.
notes: The official archive verifies January to March and April to June 2026 editions. The editions have period labels rather than a verified publication day, so no exact sample date is recorded. The organisation's role is health and wellbeing service provision; newsletter availability does not reveal or provide access to clients.
participationNotes: The contact page distinguishes clinic appointments from its general contact and feedback form. A public editorial or newsletter-contribution policy was not verified. Any organisational enquiry should use the published contact route and identify its purpose.

name: North Stradbroke Island Aboriginal & Islanders Housing Co-operative
area: Dunwich and Minjerribah / North Stradbroke Island
description: Community organisation providing affordable housing, aged care, home support and day respite on Minjerribah. Its public site explains its services, community activities, governance and membership process.
sampleTitle: Housing, home support and day respite services
notes: The homepage describes social activities alongside home support and respite. It is undated. Nareeba Moopi Moopi Pa and Minjerriba respite services are programmes of this organisation and are not counted as separate organisations here.
participationNotes: The published membership page limits membership to Quandamooka People who meet its criteria, with board review. Housing and care services have their own processes. Use the organisation's contact page for an enquiry rather than assuming open membership or access to residents.

name: COOEE Indigenous Family and Community Education Centre
area: Cleveland, Redlands and the Bay Islands, extending to Wynnum and nearby areas
description: Elders-founded community organisation supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander families and young people through education, cultural leadership, mentoring and wellbeing programmes. It has a public contact form and programme information.
notes: The official site describes COOEE as an Indigenous community initiative founded by Elders, with a Cleveland contact address. The About page is undated; the accessible page and indexed newer text differ, so no claim is made about the present operation or membership of a particular provider network.
participationNotes: Use the public organisation contact form to ask about current programmes and relevant participation conditions. The listing identifies COOEE's public role and does not assume access to its families, young people, Elders or private groups.
